summary.text: Val Guest is a Republican attorney and member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 106, in office since November 14, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Marisa McCann is also on the general election ballot for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Val Guest was born in Greenville, South Carolina, and lives in Myrtle Beach.
Guest earned a B.S. in business administration and management from The Citadel in 1982 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 1989.
His career includes work as an attorney and partner with Ouverson, Guest & Carter PA, and he has served as president of the Horry County Bar Association and the Surfside Rotary Club.
Guest succeeded Russell Fry as the District 106 representative.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the House Ethics Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
